### 🟢 Approval recommended The request-ID sampling update has no active review issues. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes Honeybadger event sampling so string-keyed request IDs receive the same request-stable sampling as symbol-keyed IDs. **Changes:** - Adds a string-key fallback while preserving symbol-key precedence. - Adds specs covering inclusion, exclusion, and precedence when both key styles are present. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `spec/​unit/​honeybadger/​agent_spec.rb` | Tests string-keyed request ID sampling and symbol-key precedence. | | `lib/​honeybadger/​agent.rb` | Uses either request ID key style for CRC-based sampling. |
